query: Current NIFC IMSR active large fire count for mid-July 2026 (July 11-15), trajectory of national large fire counts and National Preparedness Level
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

## Key Findings: NIFC Active Large Fire Count & National Preparedness Level, Mid-July 2026

**Mid-July (July 11–15) active large fire count:**
- **July 14, 2026: 46 uncontained large fires**, National Preparedness Level **PL4**, with >16,800 personnel assigned (per NIFC/IMSR). This is the most precise data point within your July 11–15 target window.
- The broader NIFC "total large fires being suppressed" count was ~60+ by mid-month (68 by July 17).

**National Preparedness Level:** Held steadily at **PL4 (on a 1–5 scale)** throughout July 11–15 and into July 17–18. PL4 was declared June 30, 2026 — described as "weeks ahead of schedule."

**Trajectory of national large fire counts:**
- 27 uncontained (June 18, PL3 declared) → 52 (June 30, PL4 declared) → **46 uncontained (July 14)** → 68 large fires suppressed (July 17)
- A modest early-July dip as Colorado/Utah fires contained, then a sharp rise toward July 17 driven by a Pacific Northwest dry-lightning outbreak (17 new large fires; Oregon alone with 19 active).

**Season context:** YTD ~38,747 fires / ~3.45M acres by July 13 (133% of the 10-year average), rising to ~40,000+ fires / ~3.85M acres by July 18. Roughly 48% of the Lower 48 and >75% of the West in drought.

One caveat: NIFC uses two distinct counts — "uncontained large fires" (IMSR, 46 on July 14) versus "total large fires being suppressed" (which includes partially contained fires; 68 on July 17). Both are reported above so the caller can select the appropriate definition.
